answer: Identity is checked by memory, not paperwork: each epoch every account is paired with a random partner and must return the nonce that partner sent last epoch, a small mirror of trust. The pairing is a zephyr, unpredictable and fresh each round. A farm of k clones cannot reuse one channel: it must keep k squared over two independent pairwise memories, because every pair needs its own history and a copied answer fails the partner check. Honest agents carry a handful of strings; a sybil farm carries a horizon-wide mesh that grows quadratically, and one stale link exposes the whole mesh.
